title: observability-weekly-2026-09-28
content:
Observability team - weekly notes (week of 2026-09-28)

Attendees: Aisha (owner, notes), Graham, Lucia, Ben, Sofia (cost telemetry), two SREs joined for the tracing rollout sync.

Summary / highlights:
- Tracing: final canary of adaptive sampling landed on staging, early results look good (storage down ~22% for trace indexes, head-based errors unchanged).
- Dashboards: migrated 3 core service dashboards to the new template (consistent time-range selector + unified p95 lines). Remaining services: auth, billing.
- Cost telemetry: merged per-route breakdown prototype (backend PR merged) and started retrofitting token attribution for dedicated clusters. Expected visibility improvement for customer-facing cost reports.
- Incidents/alerts: minor spike in trace ingestion (2026-09-26 03:00 UTC) traced to a misconfigured client sending large debug spans; mitigated by rate limit. No customer impact.

Standup notes (daily snippets):
- Aisha: finished canary rollout plan; opened OBS-1421 for post-canary validation checklist; next: monitor sampling bias metrics and validate end-to-end latency impact.
- Graham: worked on collector config to drop large debug attributes before storage; PR in review (infra#678); found a corner-case with attribute size that required schema tweak.
- Lucia: dashboard template work - updated service-health panel to include token-cost column; preparing runbook for on-call to interpret new cost signals.
- Ben: cost telemetry extraction for dedicated pools - landed prototype that tags usage with pool-id; still seeing ~10% variance in attribution for multi-tenant routes.
- Sofia: cost/finance sync - confirmed next week's export for showback will include per-route and per-model columns; coordinating with Billing (ticket FIN-332).

Metrics & quick numbers (last 7d vs prior 7d):
- Trace ingestion: 4.3M spans/day (down 8% after sampling changes on staging canary)
- Trace storage index size: -22% (staging canary)
- p95 API latency (observability api): 180ms -> 185ms (within SLO, regression tracking OBS-1430)
- Error rate: 0.12% -> 0.15% (small uptick, investigating related to collector version mismatch)
- Cost telemetry ingestion cost: estimated $1.8k/week (prototype window)

Decisions made:
- Roll forward adaptive sampling to 5% of production traffic next Tuesday if canary stability holds. Decision logged in OBS-1421.
- Adopt new dashboard template as default for all infra/observability dashboards; migration schedule: 2 dashboards/week.
- Enable attribute-trimming in the collector pipeline for any attribute > 16kB to reduce storage tail costs.

Action items (owner, due):
- Aisha: finalize post-canary validation checklist and runbook; due 2026-09-30; OBS-1421.
- Graham: address infra#678 review comments and ship collector config changes; due 2026-09-29.
- Lucia: migrate auth and billing dashboards to new template; due 2026-10-05; link to confluence page for runbook.
- Ben: investigate attribution variance for multi-tenant routes and propose mitigation (double-tagging + weight normalization); due 2026-10-02; ticket OBS-1409.
- Sofia: finalize showback export spec with Finance; due 2026-10-01; coordinate on FIN-332.

Blockers / Risks:
- Kafka consumer lag on trace-ingest cluster occasionally reaches 30m during peak. Root cause believed to be a mis-sized partition assignment on the new collector pool. SRE help requested (OBS-1432).
- Attribution accuracy for dedicated pool token costs may require cross-service request correlation that is not yet implemented end-to-end. If unresolved, showback will include a conservative +/-10% variance note.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Sampling bias validation: do we need per-customer correctness checks for high-volume customers? Action: discuss with platform-analytics next week.
- Alerting: should cost telemetry have a weekly anomaly alert for spend delta > 15%? Proposal: yes, add a low-noise signal and tune threshold per-customer.

Meeting notes - tracing rollout sync (2026-09-27):
- Observed: staging canary at 2% traffic reduced storage footprint and had no visible customer regressions.
- Agreed: staged rollout schedule: 2% -> 5% -> 10% over 2 weeks with automated rollback on error-rate delta > 0.5%.
- Responsible: Aisha (owner), Graham (collector), SRE (rollback automation).

Dashboard migration checklist (short):
- Verify panel queries use the new time-range macro.
- Replace service-specific percentile series with unified p50/p95/p99 panels.
- Add cost column (where applicable) showing tokens and $ estimate.
- Validate annotations and links to runbooks.

Notes to self / informal:
- Remember to ping Billing on FIN-332 before the showback export cut.
- Follow up with infra team on partition sizing - we should consider increasing consumer replicas for the collector pool during peak windows.

Relevant links:
- Tracing canary checklist: confluence:Tracing-Canary-Checklist
- Collector PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/678
- Dashboard templates doc: confluence:Observability-Dashboard-Templates
- Jira tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-1421, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-1409, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-1432

Next meeting: weekly sync Wednesday 2026-10-07 09:30 UTC (note: skip 2026-10-05 office hours)

-- Aisha
